device.description: 12-bit 200 kHz 2.7 V micropower sampling SAR ADC with synchronous serial interface
device.note: ads7822-q1.pdf (SGLS299) p.3 specifications at 2.7 V (VIH 2.0-5.5 V, straight binary), p.4 VCC ranges, p.5 specifications at 5 V, p.6 pin configuration and assignments, p.12 serial interface and Figure 22, p.13 Table 1 timing, p.15 data format; ads7822.pdf (SBAS062C) p.2 ordering (MSOP-8 DGK and SO-8 D), p.5 pin configuration, p.12 Table 1

pages: ads7822-q1.pdf: p.3 (VIH 2.0-5.5 V at 2.7 V, straight binary), p.4 (VCC 2.7-3.6 V specified, 2.0-2.7 V with notes), p.5 (VCC 4.75-5.25 V, VIH 3.0-5.5 V), p.6 (pins), p.12 (Figure 22), p.13 (Table 1: tdDO 200 ns max at 2.7 V, tdis 80 ns, ten 175 ns), p.15 (data format); ads7822.pdf: p.2 (ordering: E = MSOP-8 DGK, U = SO-8 D), p.5 (pin configuration, same pinout)
notModeled: analog input; the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (12 clocks, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the first two DCLOCK edges (sample time 1.5-2.0 clocks), then the null bit, then B11..B0; after B0 the part outputs the result LSB-first and then zeros or tri-states (Figure 22 notes) - all zeros for the 0 V code, so idle 0 covers it
auto power-down after the conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
vcc 2.0-5.25 V spans the VCC rows of both specification tables (2.0-2.7 V with reduced clock rate, 2.7-3.6 V, 4.75-5.25 V); timing uses the 2.7 V column of Table 1
throughput (200 kHz) and DCLOCK frequency limits
variants: ADS7822-Q1 (ADS7822IDGKRQ1, automotive, DGK) and ADS7822B/C (EB, EC, UB, UC) grades are the same part (same spec). ads7822.pdf covers the commercial E/U parts with the same pinout and interface.
